name: Active Recall
description: Close your notes and explain or answer from memory

name: Spaced Repetition
description: Review material at increasing time intervals

name: Practice-Based Learning
description: Solve exercises from easy to hard and review mistakes

name: Step-by-Step Problem Solving
description: Break each problem into small checked steps

name: Deliberate Practice
description: Practice exercises that target a specific weakness

name: Code Tracing
description: Follow code line by line and track variable values

name: Charting Method
description: Compare concepts side by side in a table
